purpose: Conditional locational-flexibility robustness and baseline study, declared before new scenario outcomes.
preparation: Reuse the v3 prepared state: 60 source-bounded taps, capacitor 74564 disconnected, fixed local generator targets and calibrated HVDC boundary. No limits increased.
portfolio_selection: Wind bus, Dublin comparator, and the six closest other live >=100 kV original buses in the prepared in-service unweighted branch graph; choose ties by source bus ID before any candidate outcome.
price_scope: No observed site tariffs supplied. Do not manufacture price-only advantage; a common wholesale price cannot distinguish these simultaneous locations.
search_scope: Best tested points only. Coarse grid plus local refinement above the highest passing coarse point; no global/monotone optimum certificate.
acceptance_checks: original numerical voltage, P/Q generator and available branch limits
explicit ideal-tie flow recovery under stated allocation
infeasible_policy: Retain and display no-eligible-point and failed checks. Never replace failed physical results with a score or widened limits.
analysis: Report valid paired comparisons, positive/neutral/negative differences using the predeclared 0.5 MW threshold; deterministic scenario grid, not a statistical population sample.
scale_measurement: Record solver calls and end-to-end elapsed time, including checked-point verification; descriptive single-machine timings, no cross-system speed claim.
value_bridge: Conditional duration * MW; incremental value and activation premium entered as scenario assumptions. No annual/field MWh, observed tariffs, profit or CO2 claims without supplied evidence.
ai_scope: No live Azure calls; all physical comparisons deterministic. AI remains a bounded investigation interface.
